metadata.description: Research Desk: seven research skills for Claude (citation check, literature notes, paper comparison, related work, paper critique, decision matrix, LLM council) and a reference checker.

plugins.name: research-desk
plugins.description: Research work you can stand behind: check that references are real, take faithful notes on a paper, compare papers, draft related work from your own sources, review a draft like a referee, decide between options with a weighted matrix, and get a judged second opinion. Says plainly what it could not verify.
